prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 84.5%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 90.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 80.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 83.6%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 71.7%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 36.7%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Multi-Tab Species & Customization Deck: Redesign the pet picker into a multi-tab choice deck that categorizes pets by species and personality traits before selection. (why: Adoption stage takes a median of 89s and mean of 1017s; structured categorization simplifies decision making and speeds up adoption.)
1: [home, new_screen] Live Desktop Companion Arrival Preview Screen: Add a new landing preview screen before waiting that illustrates how pets spawn and dock onto the user's taskbar. (why: Users take mean 2336s on home stage, and support received 3 complaints about pets not showing up on the desktop.)
2: [sign_in, new_flow] Account Session Pre-Verification Diagnostic Flow: Introduce a pre-verification check flow during sign-in that scans for existing cloud pet saves before completing login. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or resetting after signing in again, and 2 users had sign-in stalling issues.)
3: [choose_path, reorder] Welcome Story Before Path Selection Restructure: Reorder the onboarding flow sequence to display path selection immediately following story introduction. (why: Path selection dropoff leaves overall conversion at 36.7%, and mean time spent on path choice is 514s.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Existing Pet Sync Banner Notice: Display an informative hint banner on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that existing pets will be restored. (why: Support logged 8 messages concerning lost pets after re-authenticating.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Taskbar & Window Docking Guide during Waiting: Show interactive tips during the rendering wait screen explaining desktop pet placement and system tray visibility. (why: Mean wait screen duration is 2336s and 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on screen.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop Companion Ready System Bell Switch: Include an audio alert switch on the waiting screen to alert users when their pet spawn rendering finishes. (why: Users spend a mean of 2336s on the waiting screen, indicating the app is left in the background.)
7: [finish, copy] Desktop Controls & System Tray Guidance Headline: Update final screen text to clearly direct users to the system tray and right-click menu for pet controls. (why: Finish screen conversion is 71.7% and 3 support emails asked how to control or hide pets post-onboarding.)
8: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Quality Diagnostic & Preview Check: Insert an automated image diagnostic screen after photo upload to verify lighting and resolution before rendering. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual output.)
